column1: # This file only decides what ZAP reports. It does not decide what blocks: the
# merge gate is scripts/check-scan-findings.mjs against scripts/scan-allowlist.json,
# which fails on every alert at or above MEDIUM that has no owner, expiry and
# reason. Silencing an alert here instead of accepting it there hides it from that
# review, so add a rule here only for an alert the scan cannot produce truthfully,
# never for one that is merely inconvenient.
